page.overview:
Who is The Immortal?

The Immortal is a supporting character in Invincible. He is an immortal superhero who has lived for thousands of years and left a significant mark on human history, assuming numerous identities throughout his life. Among these, he lived as a medieval knight, possibly associated with Arthurian legend, and later as Abraham Lincoln, before eventually adopting the superhero identity of the Immortal in the early 20th century, becoming the world's first official superhero.

He was a member of the original Guardians of the Globe and the only member to eventually return after the team was murdered by Omni-Man. Following his resurrection, the Immortal joined the newly formed Guardians and later assumed leadership of the team, replacing Robot. During this period, he also entered a relationship with Dupli-Kate, who, out of all his previous lovers, understood his struggle with experiencing death recurrently.

Following Kate's apparent death by the Komodo Dragon and his own struggles as a leader, the Immortal temporarily stepped away from the Guardians while grieving her loss. After discovering that Kate had survived, the two reunited and eventually became engaged. He subsequently returned to active duty and continued serving with the Guardians through the events of the Invincible War. In the aftermath, the Immortal retired alongside Kate, leaving superhero work behind so that the two could start a family together.

The Immortal is a tall, fair skinned man with jet-black hair, blue eyes, and a full beard with a clean-shaven upper lip. He has strong, angular facial features and a large, well-defined muscular build.
